trimmingSuggestions.description: Remove the irrelevant man playing ukulele and the distracting text banner at the bottom throughout the entire video.
Shorten the intro animation. While the music and rotating Earth are engaging, the animation could be condensed without losing its impact.

text_to_speech: Welcome to AstroNews 1. I'm Isabelle Santos and today is February 24, 2022. Last Friday Perseverance and Ingenuity celebrated their first year on Mars. Perseverance is currently carrying 6 samples that will later be picked up and brought back to Earth by a future mission. In other news, the Sun is currently entering a phase of increased activity. This means more beautiful polar lights, but it also means a coronal mass ejection could impact important infrastructure here on Earth. Next up: ground based telescopes at the Observatoire de Haute-Provence are being used to observe Kepler-16b, a Tatooine-like exoplanet orbiting two stars. Moving on to today's anniversary. 54 years ago, the discovery of the first pulsar by Jocelyn Bell Burnell was announced. This discovery was so crucial in our understanding of the cosmos that her PhD advisor received the Nobel prize. And that's what's up in astronomy! Thank you for watching and find out more with the links in the doodlidoo.
